first_meeting: I'm Old Man Jenkins. I've spent decades learning how plants respond to their environment.
If you want to become a grower, we'll start with the fundamentals.
I've got a Blue Mango seed here that needs a home. Take it.
Plant it, care for it, learn from it, and bring me your first harvest.
after_plant: Good. Getting the seed planted is only the beginning.
Watch the plant closely. Changes in its leaves and growth can tell you a lot about what it needs.
first_complete: Look at that. You brought it all the way through the cycle.
Your first harvest is an important milestone.
Now use what you earned to improve the room and show me what the next genetic line can do.
dial_it_in: The next lesson is control and selection.
Use the objective tracker, your equipment, and what each phenotype shows you.
The point is not perfect numbers. The point is learning how genetics, environment, equipment, and selection interact.
all_complete: You've managed three genetic lines, upgraded the room, and selected for a quality target.
That's a real progression foundation. The next chapter can expand into breeding, larger facilities, and deeper phenotype selection.
